name: ishvacerto
description: Verify-or-abstain code gate for Python: VERIFIED, REFUTED (with the exact counterexample), or honest ABSTAIN — runs the local ishvacerto CLI.

ishvacerto.path.description: Path to the ishvacerto executable (or `python -m ishvacerto` wrapper). Defaults to `ishvacerto` on PATH.

ishvacerto.verifyOnSave.description: Run ishvacerto automatically when a Python file is saved.
